title: Playboy Magazine August 1970 Myra Breckinridge Paul Ehrlich Bunnies of 1970
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue. Cover shows overall toning, light soiling and edge wear, with light creasing at the corners and a small nick along the top edge. Spine intact. No mailing label. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, August 1970 issue. Cover price one dollar.

Features:
- A wild pictorial on "Myra Breckinridge" - the Raquel Welch and Mae West film of the Gore Vidal novel
- Playboy Interview with Dr. Paul Ehrlich, the biologist behind "The Population Bomb"
- Bunnies of 1970

Footprints-in-the-sand cover.

The back cover carries the 1970 Winston "Winston tastes good like a cigarette should" ad, shot on the Central Park lake - a nice piece of period advertising in its own right.

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage.
